VBO:0200725.summary: Jack-A-Poo names a Poodle cross with a Russell-type terrier; breeding programs may use Jack Russell, Parson Russell or Russell Terriers.
VBO:0200725.shortDescription: Jack-A-Poo names a Poodle cross with a Russell-type terrier; breeding programs may use Jack Russell, Parson Russell or Russell Terriers.

sources.title: StarView — own Jackapoo breeding program
sources.evidence: Fresh complete substantive breeder account explicitly defines its Jackapoo program as Poodle crossed with Jack Russell, Parson Russell or Russell Terrier. Only identity scope used; calming, allergy and inherited-character marketing rejected.

sources.title: Stoltzfus Family — actual Jackapoo litter listing
sources.evidence: New direct listing read: own litter is explicitly Jack Russell/Miniature Poodle, parents available to meet. Actual parentage corroborates name usage without making this one terrier or Poodle variety universal.
